reason: The first 16-run FACETS replay exposed two comparison-scope violations that would make a pooled FACETS-Python JMLE difference misleading: anchored facets use different free-level constraints, and sparse Person-Rater designs are structurally unidentified under the exact application eta design.

direct_result.scope: balanced_small, no anchors, exact eta rank identified, additive RSM; generator local-bias conditions 0.0 and 0.6 are both retained
direct_result.facet_rank_order: Spearman 1.0 in every retained facet/design/bias group
direct_result.claim_limit: Parser, sign, scale, and small-sample matched-JMLE numerical agreement in four smoke runs only; not general FACETS equivalence.

anchor_constraint_finding.observed: Supplied R01/R02 anchors are reproduced by both engines. Differences concentrate in free R03/R04 levels.
anchor_constraint_finding.facets_contract: Once element anchors define the absolute origin, FACETS estimates every remaining unanchored level freely.
anchor_constraint_finding.python_contract: streamlit_app.py build_facet_constraint/count_facet_params/expand_facet_with_constraints continue to apply sum-to-zero to only the remaining ungrouped free levels when the facet is centered.
anchor_constraint_finding.consequence: The current anchored Python JMLE is over-constrained relative to FACETS and is not a direct matched-estimand comparison.
anchor_constraint_finding.recommended_remediation: When an absolute element anchor or absolute group-anchor constraint identifies a facet origin, allocate one free coordinate per remaining ungrouped level. Retain sum-to-zero only when no absolute origin constraint is present, unless an explicit over-identified sensitivity model is requested.
required_tests_before_core_change: One anchor plus one free level: the free level is estimable and is not forced to zero.
Two anchors plus two free levels: free estimates need not sum to zero and match a FACETS golden fixture.
All levels anchored: zero free coordinates.
No anchors: existing sum-to-zero behavior remains unchanged.
Group-anchor and mixed hard/group-anchor cases have explicit rank and expansion tests.
JMLE analytic gradient, covariance, identifiability metadata, exported parameter meaning, and MML paths remain coherent.
anchor_constraint_finding.core_change_status: not implemented in this amendment; requires a focused mathematical change and regression review

structural_identifiability_finding.condition: sparse_missing with one Rater per Person
structural_identifiability_finding.interpretation: FACETS subset connectivity is not equivalent to full-rank identification of the application's exact Person/facet eta coordinate design. Both optimizers can return finite converged values while different constraints select different points on a nonidentified surface.
structural_identifiability_finding.decision: Retain as a negative control; exclude from direct parity and estimator-recovery claims that require identified Rater effects.

fit_rounding_finding.facets_score_output: Measure, S.E., and Displacement can be requested at six decimals with Umean=0,1,6; Infit/Outfit MnSq and ZSTD remain at two decimals.
fit_rounding_finding.facets_residual_output: Expected score, residual, variance, standardized residual, and related fields remain at two decimals in the tested tab-separated output.
fit_rounding_finding.decision: Do not reconstruct or claim raw FACETS fit parity. Store displayed values, conservative x +/- 0.005 intervals, and pass/flag/boundary_uncertain decisions.

r_runtime_reproducibility.bundle_validation: All 16 RunIds, 18,526 rating rows, four byte hashes, response support, uniqueness, and paired-anchor identities passed in operating_characteristics_bridge.R.
r_runtime_reproducibility.legacy_hash_issue: The archived operating-characteristics TAM registry uses a source-reference-sensitive serialized function hash (8083b024...). The current same-version binary produces b16c7fad... after source stripping and is blocked by the legacy TAM adapter. This is an identity-contract migration issue, not evidence of numerical disagreement.
r_runtime_reproducibility.next_action: Use the repository's later utils::removeSource stable-identity contract in a prospectively amended R adapter before rerunning TAM.

wording_correction.change: Application agreement crosswalk now says FACETS Table 7; Table 8 remains category/rating-scale output.

prohibited_interpretations: Pooling the 16 FACETS-Python differences as a single parity statistic.
Calling anchored differences estimator bias before matching constraint parameterizations.
Calling sparse differences estimator bias when the Rater estimand is structurally unidentified.
Treating optimizer convergence or FACETS subset connection as proof of full structural identification.
Treating two-decimal FACETS fit output as raw values.
Treating two smoke replicates per cell as stable operating characteristics.
